description: Settings for down payment schedules, down payment invoices, final invoices, the labour share (§ 35a EStG), dunning and incoming payments (Corevatis)

fields.label: Create Schedule with the Project
fields.description: When the project is created from the accepted offer: one down payment schedule from the template.

fields.label: Schedule Template
fields.description: 30/40/30: at start of work, on progress, at acceptance. 50/50: at start of work, at acceptance. Eigene Vorlage: lines below.

fields.label: Minimum Order Total (Net)
fields.description: No schedule for orders below this net total (0 = always)

fields.label: Down Payment Item
fields.description: Service item for down payment lines and deductions (empty: ABSCHLAG, created automatically)

fields.label: Default Labour Share (%)
fields.description: Fallback for positions without costing (minutes × hourly rate), e.g. manual supplements. 0 = no labour share shown for such positions.

fields.label: Labour Share Including Surcharges
fields.description: On (default): surcharges (overheads, profit) are allocated to material and labour by their cost shares, so material + labour = net price. Off: labour = (minutes × hourly rate + hardship) × quantity, material = remainder.

fields.label: Show Material and Labour per Position
fields.description: Quotation and invoice print a line "Material … € · Labour … €" under each position. The totals (thereof material, thereof labour) are always printed.

fields.label: Payment Reminder (Days after Due Date)
fields.description: Proposed payment reminder this many days after the due date

fields.label: Payment Deadline in the Notice (Days)
fields.description: Pay-by date printed on the notice: posting date plus these days

fields.label: Fee 1st Dunning Notice
fields.description: Payment reminders never carry a fee

fields.label: Income Account for Dunning Fees
fields.description: Empty: account 2650 (SKR03) / 7100 (SKR04), otherwise the company's default income account

fields.label: Bank Account
fields.description: Company bank account the statements belong to (empty: default company bank account, created on the first import)

fields.label: Import Credits Only
fields.description: Skip outgoing payments (debits) when importing a statement

fields.label: CSV Column: Date
fields.description: Column headings of the bank's CSV export; empty = detect Sparkasse/VR-Bank headings automatically

name: Corevatis Abrechnung Einstellungen
